component.name: geocoder
component.title: Geocoder
component.description: Look up the latitude and longitude of an address, or the address of a latitude and longitude, with Google or a Nominatim server.
component.label: api,search

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

geoApiContext.label: advanced
geoApiContext.description: To use a custom com.google.maps.GeoApiContext for the requests to Google. When it is set, the apiKey, clientId, clientKey and proxy options of the endpoints are not used.

CamelGeoCoderAddress.description: The address. The producer reads it as the address to look up, which replaces the address of the endpoint, and sets it to the formatted address of the first result.

CamelGeoCoderLatlng.description: The latitude and longitude, separated by a comma. The producer reads it as the location to look up, which replaces the latlng of the endpoint and takes precedence over an address, and sets it to the location of the first result. For Nominatim, it sets a space after the comma.

CamelGeoCoderLat.description: The latitude of the first result, with 8 decimals.

CamelGeoCoderLng.description: The longitude of the first result, with 8 decimals.

CamelGeoCoderStatus.description: The status of the lookup: OK, or ZERO_RESULTS when no place is found. When Google rejects the request, it is REQUEST_DENIED, OVER_QUERY_LIMIT, OVER_DAILY_LIMIT, INVALID_REQUEST or UNKNOWN_ERROR, and for an error answer of Nominatim it is ERROR. The producer sets the other headers only when the status is OK, except that for the address current it sets CamelGeoCoderLatlng to the geolocated location also when the status is ZERO_RESULTS.

CamelGeoCoderRegionCode.description: The code of the first-level administrative area, such as a state. With Google, the short name of the administrative_area_level_1 address component, and with Nominatim the state_code of the address in upper case.

CamelGeoCoderRegionName.description: The name of the first-level administrative area, such as a state. With Google, the long name of the administrative_area_level_1 address component, and with Nominatim the state of the address.

CamelGeoCoderCity.description: The name of the city. With Google, the long name of the locality address component, and with Nominatim the city of the address.

CamelGeoCoderCountryLong.description: The name of the country, such as France.

CamelGeoCoderCountryShort.description: The two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) in upper case, such as FR.

producerIn.description: The body is not read: the address or the latitude and longitude come from the CamelGeoCoderAddress or CamelGeoCoderLatlng header, or else from the endpoint

producerOut.description: With Google, the array of com.google.maps.model.GeocodingResult, empty for no results; unchanged when Google denies the request, with the status in the CamelGeoCoderStatus header. With Nominatim, its jsonv2 response as text: an array of one place for an address (empty for no results), an object for a latitude and longitude. The first result is also in the headers

address.description: The address to look up the latitude and longitude of, such as Paris, France, written after address: in the URI. With Google, the address current looks up the location of the IP address that the request comes from. The CamelGeoCoderAddress header replaces this option.

latlng.description: The latitude and longitude to look up the address of, written after latlng: in the URI as two decimal numbers separated by a comma, such as 48.8566,2.3522. The CamelGeoCoderLatlng header replaces this option. A latitude and longitude, from this option or the header, takes precedence over an address.

headersOnly.description: Whether to leave the message body as it is and only set the headers. If false, the producer sets the body to the result: an array of com.google.maps.model.GeocodingResult for Google, or the JSON response of Nominatim as a String.

language.description: The language of the answer (such as the address, the country and the city), as a language code such as en, de or fr. It is sent as the accept-language parameter to Nominatim and as the language parameter to Google.

serverUrl.description: The base URL of the Nominatim server, such as https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org, to which the producer adds /search or /reverse. Required when type is NOMINATIM, and not used for Google.

type.description: The geocoding service: GOOGLE for the Google Geocoding API, or NOMINATIM for the Nominatim server at serverUrl. If not set, Google is used.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

proxyAuthDomain.label: proxy
proxyAuthDomain.description: The domain for NTLM proxy authentication. The component does not use this option, as proxyAuthMethod accepts only Basic and Digest.

proxyAuthHost.label: proxy
proxyAuthHost.description: The host for NTLM proxy authentication. The component does not use this option, as proxyAuthMethod accepts only Basic and Digest.

proxyAuthMethod.label: proxy
proxyAuthMethod.description: The authentication method for the proxy, Basic or Digest. When it is set, the producer authenticates to the proxy with proxyAuthUsername and proxyAuthPassword. Another value fails when the producer starts.

proxyAuthPassword.label: proxy
proxyAuthPassword.description: The password for the proxy authentication, used when proxyAuthMethod is set.

proxyAuthUsername.label: proxy
proxyAuthUsername.description: The user name for the proxy authentication, used when proxyAuthMethod is set.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the HTTP proxy for the requests to Google. The proxy is used only when proxyPort is also set, and not for Nominatim.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the HTTP proxy for the requests to Google. The proxy is used only when proxyHost is also set.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The API key of the Google Maps Platform, which the producer uses when clientId is not set. Google needs either this key or clientId and clientKey. It is not used for Nominatim.

clientId.label: security
clientId.description: The client ID of the Google Maps Platform Premium Plan. When it is set, the producer signs the requests to Google with it and clientKey instead of using apiKey. The geolocation of the address current does not accept a client ID.

clientKey.label: security
clientKey.description: The URL signing secret (cryptographic key) that belongs to clientId, with which the producer signs the requests to Google.
